body.statement: Can the local-cubic handle in def:endpoint-learning-handle be completed as a measurable total learner such that, for class constants \(C,c>0\) and every sufficiently large training size \(M\), \[\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_4}P\!\left(\max_{a\in\{0,1\}}\lVert\widehat\lambda_a-\lambda_a\rVert_\infty+\max_{a\in\{0,1\}}\lVert\widehat g_a-g_a\rVert_\infty+\lVert\widehat\pi_1-\pi_1\rVert_\infty>Cr_M\right)\le CM^{-2}+CJ_M^2e^{-cMh_M^3},\] including simultaneous random-Gram inversion, fourth-order Taylor residuals, martingale numerator noise, random denominators, and fallbacks under every measurable \(f\) satisfying the density band?
body.justification: This simultaneous last-cell concentration result is the genuine open construction on which primitive-class endpoint efficiency rests.
body.gap: Cattaneo et al. (2024) have nondegenerate i.i.d. local information and a smooth design density; Jiang and Doksum (2003) stop below the upper support boundary; Munch et al. (2024) give integrated hazard rates under positive endpoint follow-up.
body.consumer: A positive answer discharges every high-level nuisance-rate assumption in thm:uniform-endpoint-efficiency and is reusable for other censoring-depleted conditional functionals.
